frequency_question: How often does an executive follow through on announced high-stakes tariff measures within the stated deadline rather than backing down or settling?
membership_rule: Includes formal presidential announcements of specific punitive or protectionist tariff rates directed at specific trading partners. Excludes generalized campaign rhetoric without formal executive escalation or standard statutory antidumping/countervailing duty processes managed entirely by independent agencies.
coverage_note: 7 named cases covering major historical executive tariff threats and implementations.
known_gaps: Excludes minor or purely negotiated threats that never reached formal proclamation stages.
validity_reason: Executive authority under trade statutes remains stable across administrations, though political style causes slight variance.
